content:
iPhone 18 Pro and iPhone Ultra will be released next month, equipped with a brand-new A20 Pro chip. This weekend, a credible leaker shared the expected performance improvement based on supply chain information.

The A20 Pro chip is expected to deliver an 18% performance boost and 30% better power efficiency.

Apple's major September event will unveil its latest chip technology achievement: the A20 Pro chip.

The A20 Pro will be Apple's first chip built on TSMC's 2nm process. There are also rumors that it will adopt a new Wafer-Level Multi-Chip Module (WMCM) packaging technology.

Based on these innovations, we have been expecting a larger-than-usual performance leap for this year's chip.

Weibo leaker "Fixed Focus Digital" posted over the weekend, claiming that according to supply chain sources, the A20 Pro will see the following upgrades over the A19 Pro:

  • 18% performance improvement
  • 30% power efficiency improvement

Of course, more precise figures will come when Apple reveals full details next month. They typically break down individual gains for the CPU, GPU, and Neural Engine.

However, if these numbers hold true, the performance boost is indeed quite impressive. The improved power efficiency should translate to longer battery life while delivering the best performance ever.

Combined with iOS 27's own speed improvements, the performance upgrades on the iPhone 18 Pro and iPhone Ultra look very promising.

What are your thoughts on the rumored performance gains of the A20 Pro? Feel free to share with us in the comments section.
